operation.summary: Implemented Layer 8 recipient-acknowledgement delivery-state presentation in the HTML Observatory, preserving Runtime-only authority and browser non-disclosure boundaries.
changes: Added Layer 8 delivery-state normalization and rendering for delivered, refused, failed, revoked, recovery, and action-release states in demos/html-observatory/app.js.
Styled the Layer 8 delivery panel without changing index.html or Runtime/OpenAPI surfaces.
Added issue-owned browser exact-eight validator, authentic handler-output handoff evidence, and exact post-bind scope validator.
